description.ls: Lists directory. Relative path works EXCEPT for '~'.
description.exit: Kill the agent process (won't delete the file)
description.sleep: Set the sleep interval for the agent.
description.cat: Reads the contents of the file. Relative path works EXCEPT for '~'.
description.shell: Spawns a shell and executes the command. Uses memfd() to execute the command and relies on PATH variable
